ticket.title: ll-craft: cross-platform process control in Python — PTY (pywinpty vs ptyprocess), psutil tree-kill with pid-reuse safety, supervision, detached children, macOS specifics
ticket.description:
Knowledge for S2 and S3 (design design-e963c656f5 §4.3, §7). Write a strategy_ll doc with code-level recipes. It must cover:
- pywinpty vs ptyprocess parity (spawn, resize, read and EOF, write, kill, exit codes) and a thin abstraction that hides both.
- Spawning interactive CLIs (claude, codex, pi) under a PTY on each OS.
- psutil process-tree kill, identifying a process by (pid, create_time), and pid-reuse safety (a child created before its parent is not its child).
- Detached and background children plus supervision: POSIX setsid/process groups vs Windows CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP/DETACHED_PROCESS/job objects.
- Signals vs CTRL_BREAK.
- A loopback-only control port with a shared secret.
- What replaces `ctypes.windll` keystroke injection on POSIX (write to the PTY master).
- macOS specifics: spawn start method, App Nap, Gatekeeper and quarantine on bundled binaries.
- CI testing of PTY code on GitHub runners.

Cite sources. Say what is proven vs assumed.

tickets.words: Today the app is hardcoded to run on my machine. I would like it to be run on anyone's machine with a proper installer and need to publish this on Git as a distributable.
